welcome_title: Where would you like to begin seeking support?
welcome_subtitle: PathFinder Health helps you organize your symptoms, applies transparent safety rules and deterministic classification, and guides you toward the most appropriate healthcare starting pathway.
welcome_disclaimer: PathFinder Health is an informational screening and care-navigation prototype. It does not provide medical diagnoses, disease predictions, or prescriptions. For life-threatening emergencies, call emergency services immediately.
consent_lead: Please review how your information is handled before proceeding.
consent_p1: 1. Purpose: This system organizes your reported symptoms to suggest whether general medical, mental health, or combined care pathways may be an appropriate starting point for professional consultation.
consent_p2: 2. Non-Diagnostic: This tool is not a doctor, does not predict illnesses, and does not prescribe medications or treatments.
consent_p3: 3. Privacy & Minimal Data: We do not collect your name, phone number, address, or email. Only symptoms, duration, and severity are processed for the screening.
consent_p4: 4. Data Retention: Screening session data is stored securely and automatically purged after 30 days. You may erase your session at any time.
consent_checkbox: I understand that PathFinder Health provides screening and care navigation guidance only, not a clinical medical diagnosis.
intake_subtitle: Select any symptoms you notice and provide timeline and functional impact details.
intake_free_text_label: Describe your situation in your own words (English, Tamil, or Tanglish):
intake_free_text_placeholder: Example: I have persistent knee pain and morning stiffness for 3 weeks... or nenju vali / thalai vali...
intake_voice_unsupported: Voice recognition is not supported in this browser. Please type below.
intake_duration_heading: How long have you noticed these symptoms?
impact_severe_disruption: Severe (unable to carry out daily tasks)
symptom_stomach_discomfort: Stomach ache, nausea, or digestive knots
symptom_loss_of_interest: Loss of interest in hobbies and activities
screening_blocked_notice: Per Section 17, 18, and 67 of the PathFinder specification, standardized screening instruments (PHQ-9, GAD-7) require official publisher-verified PDF sources and cryptographic SHA-256 verification. Because these files are not present in this installation, screening fails-closed safely without fabricating questions or cutoffs. Deterministic intake classification remains fully functional.
processing_step1: Reviewing your reported symptoms and timeline
processing_step2: Evaluating authoritative safety gate and red-flag criteria
processing_step3: Computing evidence coverage across health dimensions
processing_step4: Determining independent risk level and care-navigation pathway
results_coverage_subtext: Proportion of required health dimensions documented (symptoms, duration, severity, impact). Never represents disease probability.
urgent_lead: Your responses indicate symptoms that require prompt evaluation by an emergency medical professional or crisis service.
urgent_action_1: Call emergency medical services immediately (911 in US, 112 or 108 in India / Tamil Nadu, 999 in UK).
urgent_action_2: Do not attempt to drive yourself to a hospital if you feel faint, confused, or in severe distress.
urgent_action_3: Notify someone nearby so they can assist you.
nav_physical_subtitle: Your symptoms indicate that consulting a primary care practitioner or general physician is the most appropriate first step.
nav_mental_subtitle: Your evidence indicates that seeking support from a licensed mental health professional or psychologist is recommended.
nav_overlapping_subtitle: Your responses demonstrate both physical and emotional symptoms, suggesting an integrated healthcare team approach.
nav_insufficient_subtitle: We do not have sufficient evidence to recommend a specific pathway. Consider keeping a daily symptom log and speaking with a general healthcare professional.
nav_prep_steps: How to Prepare for Your Consultation
history_subtitle: Records stored locally in your browser. Raw access tokens and health data are not stored here.
history_empty: No previous local screening sessions found.
demo_modal_subtitle: Choose a pre-configured scenario to test deterministic classification and safety gates.
